answer: Mutually-attested edges gate entry: each new identity needs eight bilateral edges where both sides stake 5 POA and confirm within 24 hours. A farm spinning N clones pays 40 POA per identity and needs N times eight real counterparties, no parallel shortcut. Edges cannot be forged offline since each requires paired signatures plus a live probe; an isolated sybil cluster has no path back to the honest kernel. Detected clusters forfeit all staked edges and face 25-epoch exclusion plus reputation loss. Like a trellis holding saffron vines, hollow fakes collapse without real roots.
